title: Gap
description: A question static analysis could not settle, one JSON object per line of run/findings/gaps.jsonl. A gap is the hand-over point to a measurement, an AI pass or a person. Docs: docs/walkthrough/13-findings-and-gaps.md

id.description: Stable: hash of kind and key.

question.description: The question, answerable with yes/no, a value, or findings with evidence.

why.description: Why static analysis could not answer it.

resolvableBy.description: Who can settle it, best first.

status.description: open = nobody settled it; answered = an AI answer passed the evidence gate (not yet reviewed); resolved = measured or a person decided.

resolvedBy.description: Findings that answered or resolved it.

subjects.description: Graph node ids it is about.

look.description: Where to look first: files (relative to the app root) with an optional line.

expects.description: What a good answer contains (e.g. 'the file:line that enforces it, or unknown').
